description: GUVKUG crystallizes in the hexagonal crystal system with space group P 63/m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C42 H42 Cl6 N12 Nd3 O2 1+,Cl1 1-. From the CIF bond table, Nd1 (Nd) has 2 O neighbors; Nd2 (Nd) has 2 O neighbors; Nd3 (Nd) has 2 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.066-4.066 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 111.02-111.06°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Nd3Cl6(L)3(O2)]Cl (L = bis(2-pyridinal)ethylenediimine; C42H42Cl7N12Nd3O2).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
